title: cyan god apples
description: Makes god apples cyan but keeps the normal ones golden
body:
Cyan God Apples

A visual overhaul for Minecraft’s most powerful golden fruit.

This resource pack replaces the enchanted golden apple with a custom cyan themed design.

Designed for clean integration into vanilla-style gameplay while giving the item a more distinct identity in PvP, survival progression, and custom servers.

Features
Replaces enchanted golden apple texture
